title: How to become an Occupational Psychologist - Organisational Psychology

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 各位心理学家，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性的收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员计划和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于 2022 年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家完成他们的学习之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的额外独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 详情请查看描述中链接的我的奖励页面。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，随时可以找我。

sentences.en: Coming up in today's episode, we are looking at the field of occupational psychology.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我们将探讨职业心理学领域。

sentences.en: I am joined by a guest who is just coming to the very end of the process in qualifying in this fascinating career that bridges the gap between the workplace and human behavior.
sentences.zh: 我邀请到了一位嘉宾，她即将完成这一迷人职业的资格认证过程，该职业架起了职场与人类行为之间的桥梁。

sentences.en: Whether you are listening because you are looking for a career change or maybe looking to dive in at an earlier stage of your career, then you are in the right place.
sentences.zh: 无论你是为了寻求职业转型而收听，还是想在职业生涯的早期阶段深入了解，你都来对地方了。

sentences.en: We look at the key aspects of this career, how to get started, how to get qualified, and so much more.
sentences.zh: 我们将探讨这一职业的关键方面、如何入门、如何获得资格等等。

sentences.en: Hope you find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这很有用。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到《有抱负的心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent, and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Trent 博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: One of the joys of creating this podcast is that I'm able to illuminate different facets of professional psychology careers.
sentences.zh: 制作这个播客的乐趣之一，就是我能够阐明专业心理学职业的不同侧面。

sentences.en: And I wanted to revisit in more detail something that we spoke about with Dr. Mari Kovenen when we were looking at a variety of issues,
sentences.zh: 我想更详细地重温一下我们之前与 Mari Kovenen 博士讨论过的一些话题，当时我们探讨了各种问题，

sentences.en: including growing up in Finland and looking at dating in psychology and occupational psychology.
sentences.zh: 包括在芬兰长大、心理学领域的约会以及职业心理学。

sentences.en: But I wanted to dedicate a whole episode to occupational psychology, which is what we are doing today.
sentences.zh: 但我还是想专门用一期节目来谈谈职业心理学，这就是我们今天要做的事情。

sentences.en: It's going to be really useful for you, whatever stage of career you are at and whether you are interested in occupational psychology or not.
sentences.zh: 无论你处于职业生涯的哪个阶段，也无论你是否对职业心理学感兴趣，这期节目对你来说都会非常有用。

sentences.en: I think there's something to be gained by listening to it or watching it.
sentences.zh: 我认为无论是听还是看，都能有所收获。

sentences.en: That said, if you are watching on YouTube, please do subscribe, like, share the content, drop me a comment below.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，如果你是在 YouTube 上观看，请务必订阅、点赞、分享内容，并在下方给我留言。

sentences.en: In the episode, we do talk about whether there is funding available for student finance, and my guest wasn't quite sure of the answer.
sentences.zh: 在节目中，我们确实讨论了是否有学生资助，我的嘉宾当时不太确定答案。

sentences.en: I've had a little bit of a Google, and it looks like the best thing to do is to contact the student finance department in the country that you are living in.
sentences.zh: 我稍微谷歌了一下，看起来最好的办法是联系你所在国家的学生资助部门。

sentences.en: So I'm in England.
sentences.zh: 我是在英格兰。

sentences.en: For me, it would be student finance England, because it seems to be done on a case by case basis,
sentences.zh: 对我来说，就是英格兰学生资助中心，因为它似乎是根据具体情况逐案处理的，

sentences.en: depending on what stage of career you are at and whether you've had previous funding.
sentences.zh: 取决于你处于职业生涯的哪个阶段，以及你之前是否获得过资助。

sentences.en: I would love to know what you think of this episode.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道你对这期节目的看法。

sentences.en: I hope you find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得它很有用。

sentences.en: I will catch up with you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后再见。

sentences.en: I just want to welcome along our guests for today.
sentences.zh: 我想欢迎我们今天的嘉宾。

sentences.en: Hi, Jo.
sentences.zh: 嗨，Jo。

sentences.en: Hi, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 嗨，Marianne。

sentences.en: Thanks for inviting me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你的邀请。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you so much for saying yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，非常感谢你答应参加。

sentences.en: So we got chatting on LinkedIn, and I was like, would you fancy coming on and doing a podcast episode?
sentences.zh: 我们在 LinkedIn 上聊了起来，我就问，你想不想来做一期播客节目？

sentences.en: And thankfully, you said yes.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地，你答应了。

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that's one of my, I like saying yes to lots of things.
sentences.zh: 这是我的一个特点，我喜欢答应很多事情。

sentences.en: So that's one of my, one of my potential pitfalls.
sentences.zh: 所以这是我的一个潜在陷阱。

sentences.en: But yes, I was really excited about this.
sentences.zh: 但确实，我对此感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: So thank you.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you for squeezing me in at a time when actually you're quite busy anyway,
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢你在百忙之中抽出时间来参加，

sentences.en: because you've just been telling me that you're kind of coming to the end stages of getting everything sorted,
sentences.zh: 因为你刚才告诉我，你正处于处理所有事情的最后阶段，

sentences.en: so that you can call yourself an occupational psychologist, which is very exciting.
sentences.zh: 这样你就可以称自己为职业心理学家了，这非常令人兴奋。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, in fact, I've just spent this morning finishing off my amends to send my thesis, submit my thesis to the examiners so I can get that rubber stamped.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我今天早上刚花时间完成了修改，要把论文提交给考官，这样我就能盖章认证了。

sentences.en: And then that kind of closes that journey, which has been an amazing journey.
sentences.zh: 那也就结束了这段旅程，这是一段了不起的旅程。

sentences.en: I'm really obviously looking forward to sharing some of it with you today.
sentences.zh: 显然，我非常期待今天能与你分享其中的一些内容。

sentences.en: Oh, congratulations in advance.
sentences.zh: 哦，提前恭喜你。

sentences.en: And tell us a little bit about how did you come to doing this particular field in psychology?
sentences.zh: 能告诉我们你是如何进入心理学这个特定领域的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I know everyone's got an interesting story, so I'm a little bit biased in saying that mine's super interesting.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我知道每个人都有有趣的故事，所以我说我的故事超级有趣可能有点主观。

sentences.en: But I guess it's interesting in that there was quite a significant career transition.
sentences.zh: 但我认为有趣之处在于，我经历了一次相当重大的职业转型。

sentences.en: So, I spent the first almost 20 years of my career in sales and marketing and a very traditional career in terms of, you know, looking for promotions.
sentences.zh: 我职业生涯的前 20 年几乎都在销售和营销领域，在寻求晋升方面，那是一份非常传统的职业。

sentences.en: It was that traditional kind of vertical linear type career in sales and marketing.
sentences.zh: 那是销售和营销领域那种传统的垂直线性职业。

sentences.en: And got to a point where, you know, I was marketing director and sales responsibility across Europe, big team, everything I'd always wanted.
sentences.zh: 后来我达到了一个阶段，我担任了营销总监，负责整个欧洲的销售，带领着大团队，拥有了我一直想要的一切。

sentences.en: But something, you know, it wasn't evidently, it wasn't really.
sentences.zh: 但有些事情，显然，并不是真的那样。

sentences.en: So, I got there and then went, oh, actually, this isn't really what I want to do anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以我达到了那个目标，然后心想，哦，实际上，这不再是我真正想做的事情了。

sentences.en: Also, at the time, from a contextual perspective, I had a small child.
sentences.zh: 而且当时，从背景来看，我有一个小孩。

sentences.en: I was trying to be this great mom, trying to be this great boss, trying to be superwoman in all domains.
sentences.zh: 我试图成为一个伟大的母亲，一个伟大的老板，试图在所有领域都成为女超人。

sentences.en: And, you know, that then kind of started having some consequences for my well-being.
sentences.zh: 然后，这开始对我的幸福感产生了一些影响。

sentences.en: And I recognised that and decided to take charge and do something different.
sentences.zh: 我意识到了这一点，并决定掌控局面，做一些不同的事情。

sentences.en: So, I exited my corporate career, as I said, after almost 20 years and started off with my own consultancy.
sentences.zh: 所以，正如我所说，在近 20 年后，我退出了企业生涯，开始了自己的咨询业务。

sentences.en: And actually, in those first couple of years, it was a marketing consultancy.
sentences.zh: 实际上，在最初的几年里，那是一家营销咨询公司。

sentences.en: I just took, you know, this is what I do, this is what I'm good at and brought it into consulting.
sentences.zh: 我只是想，这就是我所做的，这就是我擅长的，并把它带到了咨询中。

sentences.en: Then I started finding a lot of the work I was doing was using some of my kind of leadership skills that I'd kind of developed over my corporate career,
sentences.zh: 后来我开始发现，我所做的大部分工作都在运用我在企业生涯中培养的一些领导技能，

sentences.en: doing leadership work, doing management change projects, helping organisations going through change.
sentences.zh: 做领导力工作，做管理变革项目，帮助组织经历变革。

sentences.en: And I started kind of realising this is this is quite different, but this is what I really like.
sentences.zh: 我开始意识到这非常不同，但这正是我真正喜欢的。

sentences.en: And that's when I started exploring opportunities to actually, you know, build my credentials through education.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那时，我开始探索机会，通过教育来真正建立我的资历。

sentences.en: So that's when I started looking at courses that would enable me to be better at that, be more informed, use evidence-based practice as opposed to just going out on the whim.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始寻找能让我在这方面做得更好、更专业、使用循证实践而不是仅仅凭一时冲动的课程。

sentences.en: And that's when I came across the Masters in Occupational Psychology at Birkbeck.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我发现了伯克贝克学院的职业心理学硕士课程。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: So you decided to take the plunge.
sentences.zh: 所以你决定放手一搏。

sentences.en: I took the plunge, went back to studying after 22 years.
sentences.zh: 我放手一搏，在 22 年后重返校园学习。

sentences.en: My undergraduate degree was in social science.
sentences.zh: 我的本科学位是社会科学。

sentences.en: I majored in economics and sociology.
sentences.zh: 我主修经济学和社会学。

sentences.en: So I don't have a psychology degree.
sentences.zh: 所以我没有心理学学位。

sentences.en: Well, I kind of do now.
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在算是有了一个。

sentences.en: But so I didn't, you know, that was more of a social science.
sentences.zh: 但当时确实没有，那更偏向社会科学。

sentences.en: And so I enrolled on the organisational psychology master's programme at Birkbeck.
sentences.zh: 所以我注册了伯克贝克学院的组织心理学硕士课程。

sentences.en: I did it full time in a year because I was so desperate to learn it all really quickly.
sentences.zh: 我全职读了一年，因为我太渴望快速学习这一切了。

sentences.en: In hindsight, that might not have been the best idea, but that's the route I took.
sentences.zh: 事后看来，这可能不是最好的主意，但这就是我选择的道路。

sentences.en: And then I got to near the end and I was just in a bit of a, I love this journey.
sentences.zh: 然后我快结束时，我有点……我爱这段旅程。

sentences.en: I love this.
sentences.zh: 我爱这个。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我爱它。

sentences.en: I just find this so fascinating.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得这太迷人了。

sentences.en: I don't want it to stop.
sentences.zh: 我不想让它结束。

sentences.en: And obviously because I'd chosen full time, it was.
sentences.zh: 显然因为我选择了全日制，所以它确实要结束了。

sentences.en: It was coming to an end and I wasn't really ready for it to end.
sentences.zh: 它快要结束了，而我还没准备好让它结束。

sentences.en: And so I recall talking to our professor of our department at the time saying, how do I carry on this?
sentences.zh: 所以我记得当时问我们系的教授，我该如何继续？

sentences.en: And it was just very fortuitous at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时真是太幸运了。

sentences.en: Birkbeck were bringing the professional doctorate in occupational psychology to fruition.
sentences.zh: 伯克贝克学院正在落实职业心理学的专业博士学位。

sentences.en: And I was advised that might be a nice route, you know, because I kind of wanted to work in practice as a practitioner, independent practitioner.
sentences.zh: 有人建议我那可能是一条不错的路，因为我当时想作为一名独立的从业者工作。

sentences.en: So I applied for that and managed to actually coerce one of my friends who was also on the MSC to do it so we could do it together.
sentences.zh: 所以我申请了，并成功说服了我的一位也在读硕士的朋友一起申请，这样我们就可以一起读了。

sentences.en: And we both got accepted.
sentences.zh: 我们俩都被录取了。

sentences.en: So we handed in our master's dissertations.
sentences.zh: 所以我们提交了硕士论文。

sentences.en: And a week later, we were enrolled on the professional doctorate.
sentences.zh: 一周后，我们就注册了专业博士课程。

sentences.en: And that was back in 2019.
sentences.zh: 那是在 2019 年。

sentences.en: Gosh, that's amazing.
sentences.zh: 天哪，太棒了。

sentences.en: Amazing, excellent timing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了，时机非常好。

sentences.en: But you're clearly the right candidate for those roles as well.
sentences.zh: 但显然你也是这些职位的合适人选。

sentences.en: Tell us a little bit about the professional doctorate.
sentences.zh: 给我们介绍一下专业博士学位吧。

sentences.en: So is it how big are the cohorts?
sentences.zh: 班级规模有多大？

sentences.en: Do you get paid to train?
sentences.zh: 培训有报酬吗？

sentences.en: You know, do you have to pay tuition fees?
sentences.zh: 你需要支付学费吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So you do have to pay.
sentences.zh: 所以你确实需要付费。

sentences.en: And it's something in the region of about five ish thousand pound a year.
sentences.zh: 每年大约在五千英镑左右。

sentences.en: So there is there's obviously a cost there.
sentences.zh: 所以显然是有成本的。

sentences.en: You are working while you're doing it because actually the part one.
sentences.zh: 你在学习的同时也在工作，因为实际上第一部分是这样的。

sentences.en: So if you are if you don't if you don't already have the BPS chartership, if you're going in from scratch, as I was,
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有获得英国心理学会（BPS）的特许资格，如果你像我一样从零开始，

sentences.en: the part one is you are working and you are then doing reflective learning logs based on a piece of work.
sentences.zh: 第一部分是你一边工作，一边根据工作内容撰写反思性学习日志。

sentences.en: And obviously, if you're fortunate enough, you will be getting paid for that work because I'm an independent practitioner.
sentences.zh: 显然，如果你足够幸运，你会因为那份工作获得报酬，因为我是一名独立从业者。

sentences.en: I was I did a little mixture.
sentences.zh: 我当时做了一点混合。

sentences.en: Some projects I was getting paid for other projects.
sentences.zh: 有些项目我拿到了报酬，其他项目则没有。

sentences.en: I had to do pro bono simply because I had to write.
sentences.zh: 我不得不做公益工作，仅仅是因为我必须写报告。

sentences.en: I had to do the piece of work and it was during covid.
sentences.zh: 我必须完成那项工作，而且那是在新冠疫情期间。

sentences.en: So you had to kind of make some decisions around, OK, I'll have to do some stuff and not get paid for it in order to get the qualification.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须做出一些决定，比如，好吧，我必须做一些没有报酬的事情才能获得资格。

sentences.en: So there was a little bit of a mix.
sentences.zh: 所以有一点混合。

sentences.en: You kind of cover you cover five main areas.
sentences.zh: 你涵盖了五个主要领域。

sentences.en: So selection and assessment, engagement, motivation, leadership, change and then learning and development.
sentences.zh: 即选拔与评估、参与度、动机、领导力、变革，以及学习与发展。

sentences.en: Those were the those were the five topic areas.
sentences.zh: 这些就是那五个主题领域。

sentences.en: And so you do a meaty piece of work within that domain and then you write up a sort of 5000 word reflective log on the using the consultancy cycle as the kind of framework,
sentences.zh: 你需要在该领域内完成一项实质性的工作，然后以咨询周期为框架，写一份大约 5000 字的反思日志，

sentences.en: evidence based practice to demonstrate, you know, that you have delivered work to the standard of of a doctoral student.
sentences.zh: 运用循证实践来证明你交付的工作达到了博士生的标准。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So there's those five key areas.
sentences.zh: 所以有那五个关键领域。

sentences.en: But the one thing I felt like I knew about occupational psychology wasn't there.
sentences.zh: 但我感觉我所了解的职业心理学中似乎缺少了一些东西。

sentences.en: So maybe I'm just not fitting it in.
sentences.zh: 也许我只是没把它放进去。

sentences.en: So I think the only teaching I've ever had on it was when we were doing a module or looking at sick building syndrome,
sentences.zh: 我想我唯一接受过的相关教学是在我们做一个模块时，研究了病态建筑综合症，

sentences.en: which is like when whole workforce became ill because of the way the, you know, the building was kind of set up.
sentences.zh: 就像整个员工队伍因为建筑的设置方式而生病一样。

sentences.en: And it just wasn't making people feel good and it wasn't kind of ergonomic or wasn't autonomous for human functioning.
sentences.zh: 它让人感觉不舒服，而且不符合人体工程学，也不利于人类机能的自主性。

sentences.en: So I kind of thought that was kind of partly the role of occupational psychology.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这在某种程度上是职业心理学的作用。

sentences.en: But yeah, I know.
sentences.zh: 但是的，我知道。

sentences.en: In fact, I'm there is actually a sixth area, which is well-being.
sentences.zh: 事实上，其实还有第六个领域，那就是幸福感。

sentences.en: So there is a well-being area.
sentences.zh: 所以有一个幸福感领域。

sentences.en: So some of my peers did their focus on well-being initiatives.
sentences.zh: 我的一些同学就把重点放在了幸福感倡议上。

sentences.en: So that's my mistake.
sentences.zh: 那是我的错。

sentences.en: I should have said that.
sentences.zh: 我应该提到的。

sentences.en: So well-being is quite a...
sentences.zh: 所以幸福感是一个相当……

sentences.en: In fact, I did my master's on that.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我的硕士论文就是关于这个的。

sentences.en: So I should have known that.
sentences.zh: 所以我应该知道的。

sentences.en: No worries at all.
sentences.zh: 完全不用担心。

sentences.en: So do you have like a favourite area or do you have like a dream piece of work that you like to do in occupational psychology?
sentences.zh: 那么你有没有最喜欢的领域，或者在职业心理学中有什么梦想的工作吗？

sentences.en: So my area of interest is motivation at work.
sentences.zh: 我感兴趣的领域是工作动机。

sentences.en: And my doctoral research, my thesis was in proactive behaviour at work, which is around self-initiated, change-oriented future focus, about challenging the status quo.
sentences.zh: 我的博士研究，也就是我的论文，主题是工作中的主动行为，即围绕自我驱动、以变革为导向的未来关注，以及对现状的挑战。

sentences.en: So it's that kind of behaviour that drives change.
sentences.zh: 所以，正是这种行为推动了变革。

sentences.en: And that's...
sentences.zh: 而那正是……

sentences.en: I identify as having a proactive personality.
sentences.zh: 我认定自己拥有主动型人格。

sentences.en: So it's an area I was particularly interested in as a lot of doctoral students do the thing that they kind of can relate to and want to understand a bit more about themselves.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个我特别感兴趣的领域，因为很多博士生都会选择与自己相关、并希望借此更了解自己的课题。

sentences.en: It's a bit of a sort of journey of discovery.
sentences.zh: 这算是一种探索之旅吧。

sentences.en: And that's my area that I found really fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这就是我发现非常迷人的领域。

sentences.en: I teach on the employee relations and motivation module at Birkbeck now.
sentences.zh: 我现在在伯克贝克学院教授员工关系与激励课程。

sentences.en: So I teach on the master's programme now.
sentences.zh: 我现在在硕士项目任教。

sentences.en: So it's kind of gone full circle.
sentences.zh: 所以这算是一个完整的循环。

sentences.en: And I'm an accredited coach.
sentences.zh: 而且我是一名认证教练。

sentences.en: So I particularly like doing work where I'm coaching clients who feel a bit stuck.
sentences.zh: 所以我特别喜欢做那些辅导陷入困境的客户的工作。

sentences.en: They're procrastinating, can't see a way forward.
sentences.zh: 他们正在拖延，找不到前进的方向。

sentences.en: That's kind of my...
sentences.zh: 这算是我的……

sentences.en: When someone comes to me with that as a coaching dilemma, I'm like, yes, this is the thing I love doing.
sentences.zh: 当有人带着这种教练难题来找我时，我会觉得，太棒了，这就是我热爱的工作。

sentences.en: So all things related to motivation, I find very motivating.
sentences.zh: 所以所有与激励相关的事情，我都觉得非常鼓舞人心。

sentences.en: And so that's my sort of thing I'm super interested in.
sentences.zh: 这就是我超级感兴趣的事情。

sentences.en: But I'm also really interested in leadership and, you know, the impact of leaders having experienced some great leadership,
sentences.zh: 但我对领导力也非常感兴趣，你知道，在经历过一些伟大的领导力之后，领导者会产生什么样的影响，

sentences.en: having experienced some not so great leadership and having been in a leadership role and wanting to be a really good leader.
sentences.zh: 在经历过一些不那么出色的领导力，并且自己也担任过领导角色，渴望成为一名真正优秀的领导者之后。

sentences.en: So that's also something that I'm fascinated by.
sentences.zh: 所以这也是我非常着迷的东西。

sentences.en: And it links with motivation to a certain degree.
sentences.zh: 而且它在一定程度上与激励有关。

sentences.en: Yeah, I guess nothing like working in business and seeing things done well or seeing things done really badly to inspire you to be the difference that makes the difference.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我想没有什么比在商业环境中工作，看到事情做得很好或看到事情做得非常糟糕，更能激励你成为那个带来改变的人了。

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And so now you are pretty much almost qualified.
sentences.zh: 所以现在你差不多快要拿到资格了。

sentences.en: We're going to say 99% kind of just waiting for the rubber stamping.
sentences.zh: 我们说是99%，就等着盖章了。

sentences.en: Are you going to be working just in a self-employed capacity, kind of looking for contracts?
sentences.zh: 你打算以自雇身份工作，寻找合同项目吗？

sentences.en: Do people sometimes employ occupational psychologists in an employed capacity?
sentences.zh: 人们有时会以雇佣形式聘请职业心理学家吗？

sentences.en: How does it work?
sentences.zh: 这是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: Yeah, so I'll share kind of my personal experience and then but mine is quite different to others.
sentences.zh: 是的，我会分享一下我的个人经验，不过我的情况和别人很不一样。

sentences.en: So I am, as I said, independent practitioner.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，我是独立从业者。

sentences.en: So I've got my own consultancy and I have what's called a portfolio career.
sentences.zh: 所以我拥有自己的咨询公司，并且拥有所谓的“组合职业生涯”。

sentences.en: So within that, I have my independent consultancy work.
sentences.zh: 在其中，我有我的独立咨询工作。

sentences.en: So I do some coaching.
sentences.zh: 我做一些教练辅导。

sentences.en: I do leadership development.
sentences.zh: 我做领导力发展。

sentences.en: I pick up nice little strategic projects.
sentences.zh: 我承接一些不错的战略小项目。

sentences.en: I've done sort of stuff around change, engagement, culture stuff.
sentences.zh: 我做过一些关于变革、敬业度和企业文化方面的工作。

sentences.en: So they're kind of tend to be kind of bespoke.
sentences.zh: 所以这些往往都是定制化的。

sentences.en: It's, you know, it's a short project or it can be longer.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这可能是一个短期项目，也可能更长一些。

sentences.en: So that's my kind of consultancy stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我的咨询业务。

sentences.en: Coaching, as I said, I work directly with clients, coaching clients.
sentences.zh: 教练辅导方面，正如我所说，我直接与客户合作，辅导客户。

sentences.en: I also do quite a lot of teaching coaching basics to leaders.
sentences.zh: 我也做了很多向领导者传授教练基础知识的教学工作。

sentences.en: So enable organizations to have kind of leaders as coach type prograMs.
sentences.zh: 旨在帮助组织建立“领导者即教练”类型的项目。

sentences.en: So I do quite a lot in terms of very simplified coaching.
sentences.zh: 所以我在简化版教练辅导方面做了很多工作。

sentences.en: And then I have some jobs where it's more kind of paid for roles.
sentences.zh: 然后我还有一些属于受薪职位的岗位。

sentences.en: So I'm a non-exec director for Southern Co-op.
sentences.zh: 我是南方合作社的非执行董事。

sentences.en: So that's a regional cooperative.
sentences.zh: 那是一家区域性合作社。

sentences.en: And I sit on that board.
sentences.zh: 我担任该董事会成员。

sentences.en: But I'm also the board ambassador for DE&I.
sentences.zh: 同时我还是董事会的多元、公平与包容（DE&I）大使。

sentences.en: I chair the remuneration committee.
sentences.zh: 我担任薪酬委员会主席。

sentences.en: So some of the strengths from what I do, overlays there.
sentences.zh: 所以我所做工作中的一些优势，在这里得到了体现。

sentences.en: And then, as I mentioned, I teach at Birkbeck on the master's program.
sentences.zh: 然后，正如我提到的，我在伯克贝克学院教授硕士课程。

sentences.en: Oh, a little bit of variety is definitely the spice of life, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 哦，一点点多样性绝对是生活的调味品，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes, it is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: And you mentioned that you really like change.
sentences.zh: 你提到你非常喜欢变革。

sentences.en: And for many of our listeners or watchers,
sentences.zh: 对于我们的许多听众或观众来说，

sentences.en: they might be thinking about the kind of stages of change model, which is that Prochaska and DiClemente, have I imagined that?
sentences.zh: 他们可能会想到“变革阶段模型”，就是Prochaska和DiClemente提出的那个，是我记错了吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I think there's quite a few.
sentences.zh: 我想有好几个模型。

sentences.en: I mean, Kubler-Ross is one that's cited often, which is the one that's associated to the grief model.
sentences.zh: 我是说，库伯勒-罗丝（Kubler-Ross）的模型经常被引用，它与悲伤模型相关联。

sentences.en: I mean, there's questionable evidence around it, but I know it's one that often gets used in a work context to talk about change.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，关于它的证据存在争议，但我知道它经常在工作环境中被用来讨论变革。

sentences.en: There's that's from a kind of people experiencing change and navigating change.
sentences.zh: 那是从个人经历变革和应对变革的角度来看的。

sentences.en: But then there's a whole ton of change frameworks in terms of the most optimal model of implementing a change at work.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，还有大量的变革框架，涉及在工作中实施变革的最优模型。

sentences.en: And funnily enough, one of my projects on my part one was looking at all the different change models
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，我在第一阶段的一个项目就是研究所有不同的变革模型，

sentences.en: and actually coming, trying to get the best out of and come up with something that was the most helpful.
sentences.zh: 并试图从中汲取精华，提出一个最有帮助的模型。

sentences.en: So there's lots of different theories of change.
sentences.zh: 所以有很多不同的变革理论。

sentences.en: So there's stuff that's a little bit more in depth then than the, what is it?
sentences.zh: 有些比那个更深入，那个是什么来着？

sentences.en: Contemplation, pre-contemplation, action, you know, maintenance, all of that.
sentences.zh: 沉思、沉思前、行动、你知道，维持，所有这些。

sentences.en: I think, and I think the most effective kind of frameworks are those that actually recognize going back to the context
sentences.zh: 我认为，最有效的框架是那些真正认识到回归背景的重要性，

sentences.en: and the importance of participation and the importance of kind of getting buy-in and involvement, those kind of, and communication.
sentences.zh: 以及参与的重要性，获得认同和投入的重要性，以及沟通的重要性。

sentences.en: Because one thing I've kind of learned over the years is that when change is done badly, normally at the root cause is the communication is poor.
sentences.zh: 因为多年来我学到的一点是，当变革做得糟糕时，根本原因通常是沟通不畅。

sentences.en: And so the communication is kind of at the heart of everything.
sentences.zh: 所以沟通是所有事情的核心。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it's really interesting when you look at kind of the way that staff teams function.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得观察员工团队的运作方式非常有趣。

sentences.en: So, you know, we'll have all worked in some that work really well and others that just, they just don't.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们都曾在一些运作得很好的团队工作过，也曾在一些完全不行的团队工作过。

sentences.en: Is that kind of something that occupational psychologists could get in there and sort out to help teams to thrive?
sentences.zh: 这是职业心理学家可以介入并解决，以帮助团队蓬勃发展的事情吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对可以。

sentences.en: And again, depending on the pathway, you sort of choose to go down.
sentences.zh: 同样，这取决于你选择走的路径。

sentences.en: Because as I said, it is quite interesting.
sentences.zh: 因为正如我所说，这非常有趣。

sentences.en: I've got friends who 100% work in selection and assessment.
sentences.zh: 我有朋友是100%从事选拔和评估工作的。

sentences.en: That's what they do.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的工作。

sentences.en: They do psychometrics.
sentences.zh: 他们做心理测量。

sentences.en: They, you know, it's about recruitment, selection, assessment, finding the best people for roles.
sentences.zh: 他们，你知道，就是关于招聘、选拔、评估，为职位找到最合适的人。

sentences.en: And that in itself is very specialized.
sentences.zh: 这本身就非常专业。

sentences.en: And then you've got, I've got other peers who work fundamentally, you know, in change,
sentences.zh: 然后你还有其他同行，他们主要从事变革工作，

sentences.en: whether that's change management, helping through change, navigating change, all the change type stuff.
sentences.zh: 无论是变革管理、协助变革、引导变革，还是所有与变革相关的事务。

sentences.en: I've got other colleagues who do stuff that's more around well-being, well-being initiatives, well-being interventions.
sentences.zh: 我还有其他同事做的工作更多是关于幸福感、幸福感倡议、幸福感干预。

sentences.en: So there's, it kind of depends which kind of pathway you decide to go down.
sentences.zh: 所以，这取决于你决定走哪条路。

sentences.en: I've kind of, because I kind of like, as you probably realize, have my fingers in lots of pies,
sentences.zh: 我因为，正如你可能意识到的，我喜欢多管齐下，

sentences.en: I kind of like, you know, I'm more interested in someone comes and says what the challenge is.
sentences.zh: 我比较感兴趣的是当有人来告诉我挑战是什么时，

sentences.en: And I kind of go, am I the right person?
sentences.zh: 我会想，我是合适的人选吗？

sentences.en: Have I, have I got some knowledge in this?
sentences.zh: 我对此有了解吗？

sentences.en: Do I understand it?
sentences.zh: 我理解它吗？

sentences.en: Can I get to the bottom of it?
sentences.zh: 我能弄清楚问题的本质吗？

sentences.en: And then I'll be like, yeah, that sounds like something I could get involved in.
sentences.zh: 然后我会觉得，是的，这听起来是我可以参与的事情。

sentences.en: So, so yes, but there are sort of, I don't know if I've answered that very well.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，但确实有……我不知道我是否回答得很好。

sentences.en: Have I kind of felt like I've digressed a bit?
sentences.zh: 我是不是有点离题了？

sentences.en: No, absolutely fine.
sentences.zh: 不，完全没问题。

sentences.en: So it sounds, it sounds kind of, I don't know, like it reminds me a little bit of forensic,
sentences.zh: 听起来，我不知道，这让我想起了一点法医工作，

sentences.en: where you kind of have to hold yourself accountable, get everything done and keep hoping to move through the process at the right time.
sentences.zh: 你需要对自己负责，完成所有事情，并希望在正确的时间推进流程。

sentences.en: Is there like a pathway that you kind of start on the doctorate and then three years later, you are spat out if you've kind of met all the thresholds?
sentences.zh: 是不是有一种路径，你开始读博士，然后三年后，如果你达到了所有门槛，你就会被“吐”出来？

sentences.en: Or is it a little bit more piecemeal than that?
sentences.zh: 还是说这比那更零碎一些？

sentences.en: I think the interesting thing with specifically with this, with the professional doctorate at Birkbeck,
sentences.zh: 我认为伯克贝克学院的专业博士学位特别有趣的一点是，

sentences.en: you know, the most people on it have had quite a bit of work experience.
sentences.zh: 大多数学生都有相当丰富的工作经验。

sentences.en: So we're already, you know, in work or have, you know, like me was on a, you know, second career.
sentences.zh: 所以我们已经在工作中了，或者像我一样，处于职业生涯的第二阶段。

sentences.en: So it's, and because of the nature of the part one that you are doing work related projects, you have to have access to the, those work.
sentences.zh: 而且由于第一阶段的性质是你做与工作相关的项目，你必须能够接触到那些工作。

sentences.en: As I said, some, some of my peers were employed.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，我的一些同行是被雇佣的。

sentences.en: Some, you know, within kind of think what I'm just citing some of the individuals, but, you know, someone who they worked for in selection assessment.
sentences.zh: 有些人，你知道，在……我只是引用一些例子，但有人从事选拔评估工作。

sentences.en: That's pretty much what they did.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是他们所做的。

sentences.en: Someone else who is mainly doing well-being initiatives in NHS.
sentences.zh: 还有人主要在国民医疗服务体系（NHS）做幸福感倡议。

sentences.en: So it kind of, it depends on, on, on kind of individuals, but that idea that, yeah, it's more linked to their context in which you, which you're operating,
sentences.zh: 所以这取决于个人，但那种与你所处环境更紧密联系的想法，

sentences.en: whether you're, or an independent practitioner or whether you're employed.
sentences.zh: 无论你是独立从业者还是受雇于人。

sentences.en: And then because it's quite a long journey, I've got obviously peers as well who've,
sentences.zh: 而且因为这是一个相当漫长的旅程，显然我也有同行，

sentences.en: who've moved companies, they're doing different things because you're kind of doing it alongside working.
sentences.zh: 他们换了公司，做着不同的事情，因为你是在工作的同时完成学业。

sentences.en: It's, it kind of, yeah, it's, it, everyone's path is going to be different essentially.
sentences.zh: 所以，每个人的路径本质上都是不同的。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And obviously if the circumstances for the person are right, and they've not had too much funding before, can they apply for kind of student loan,
sentences.zh: 显然，如果个人的情况合适，且之前没有获得过太多资助，他们可以申请学生贷款之类的东西来帮助支付学费吗？

sentences.en: things to kind of help with their fees and things?
sentences.zh: 不，我有能力自费。

sentences.en: No, I was in a position to be able to sell fund.
sentences.zh: 而且因为我在整个期间都在工作，显然我是在边做边赚。

sentences.en: And because I was working for the duration, I was obviously earning whilst doing.
sentences.zh: 所以它被归类为兼职。

sentences.en: So it is classed as a part-time.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时在做这个，有时也几乎是全职工作。

sentences.en: So I was doing this and pretty much working at times full-time as well.
sentences.zh: 所以。

sentences.en: So.
sentences.zh: 你最小的孩子现在多大了？

sentences.en: And how old is your youngest child now?
sentences.zh: 从你第一次觉得“我不确定这是否行得通”开始，花了多少年？

sentences.en: How many years has it taken from when you first thought,
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm not sure this is working.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她刚满13岁。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 事实上。

sentences.en: Well, she's just turned 13.
sentences.zh: 所以她是个青少年了。

sentences.en: Actually.
sentences.zh: 我离开公司职位时，她大约四岁。

sentences.en: So she's a teenager.
sentences.zh: 所以在过去的五年半里，我一直既是学生又在工作。

sentences.en: She was about, yeah, she was, she was four when I left my corporate role.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，我现在是一个青少年的妈妈，这有点吓人。

sentences.en: And so for the last five and a half years, I've been, you know, a student and working at the same time.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: So yes, I'm now a mum of a teenager, which is a bit scary.
sentences.zh: 我正处于孩子快进入青春期的阶段。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 我有一个10岁半的孩子。

sentences.en: I'm, I'm sort of hovering at the preteen.
sentences.zh: 那是完全不同的情况，但是。

sentences.en: I've got a 10 and a half year old.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: It's a whole different ballgame, but.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉，你几乎站在悬崖边上，就像，哦，我想我要走了，我想我要走了，我想我要走了，是的，我要跳下去了。

sentences.en: Oh my gosh.
sentences.zh: 我辞掉了这份企业工作，我要去做点别的事情，这既令人振奋，又令人恐惧。

sentences.en: That sense of you almost on this precipice of like, oh, I think I'm going, I think I'm going, I think I'm going, yep, I'm going to jump off.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm quitting this corporate life and I'm going to do something different, which is exhilarating, but also terrifying.
